Title: Generally available: Updated extension defaults for new Azure Functions projects

Body.Content:
New Azure Functions projects will now default to using the latest extensions. For Java, JavaScript, Powershell, and Python apps, extension bundles will default to the latest v3 version. For .NET apps, updated versions of extension NuGet packages will be referenced.

Learn more.
